## Getting Started

```{r echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
pacman::p_load(sf, tidyverse, tmap, accessibility, catchment)
```

## Geospatial Data Wrangling

### Importing geospatial data

```{r echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
mpsz <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", 
                layer = "MP14_SUBZONE_NO_SEA_PL") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)
```

```{r echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
hexagons <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", 
                    layer = "hexagons") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)
```

```{r echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
eldercare <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", 
                     layer = "ELDERCARE") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)
```

```{r echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
ODMatrix <- read_csv("data/aspatial/OD_Matrix.csv", skip = 0)
```

### Cleaning and updating attribute fields of the geospatial data

```{r}
eldercare <- eldercare %>%
  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(capacity = 100)
```

```{r}
hexagons <- hexagons %>%
  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(demand = 100) %>%
  rename(id = fid)
```

## Apsaital Data Handling and Wrangling

### Importing Distance Matrix

```{r}
ODMatrix_tidied <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  rename(from_id = origin_id,
         to_id = destination_id,
         dist = total_cost)
```

```{r}
dist2closest <- cost_to_closest(
  travel_matrix = ODMatrix_tidied,
  land_use_data = hexagons,
  opportunity = "demand",
  travel_cost = "dist",
  n = 1,
  group_by = character(0),
  active = TRUE,
  fill_missing_ids = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
hex_acc <- hexagons %>%
  left_join(dist2closest) %>%
  rename(dist2closest = dist)
```

```{r}
mapex <- st_bbox(hex_acc)
tm_shape(hex_acc,
         bbox = mapex) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "dist2closest", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("Accessibility to the closest eldercare") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

### Tidying distance matrix

```{r}
distmat <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  spread(destination_id, total_cost)%>%
  select(c(-c('origin_id')))

distmat_km <- as.matrix(distmat/1000)
```

## Calculate Catchment Ratio
```{r}
df_2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  max_cost = 5) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("2SFCA" = ".")
```

### Mapping 2SFCA
```{r}
hex_2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_2sfca)
tm_shape(hex_2SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "2SFCA", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
tm_shape(eldercare) + 
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("2SFCA Accessibility measures") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) + 
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

### Enhanced 2-step Floating Catchment 
```{r}
step_weights <- list(c(5, .01), c(4, .05), c(3, .1), c(2, .4), c(1, 1))
df_e2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand, 
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  weight = step_weights) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("E2SFCA" = ".")
```

```{r}
hex_E2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_e2sfca) 
tm_shape(hex_E2SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "E2SFCA", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("E2SFCA Accessibility measures") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

### 3-step Floating Catchment Area
```{r}
df_3sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand, 
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  step_weights, 
  normalize_weight = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("3SFCA" = ".")
```

```{r}
hex_3SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_3sfca) 
tm_shape(hex_3SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "3SFCA", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("3SFCA Accessibility measures") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

```{r}
df_m2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand, 
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  step_weights, 
  adjust_providers = function(w) w^2) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("M2SFCA" = ".")
```

```{r}
hex_M2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_m2sfca) 
tm_shape(hex_M2SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) +

tm_shape(eldercare) +

          fill = "red",

  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +

```
